part.text:
Saved and JSON-validated at [`recommendations.json`](recommendations.json).

| Stage | Level | Recommendation |
|---|---:|---|
| `prototype` | 4 | Full vibe coding for truly throwaway work, isolated from real data and credentials. |
| `proof-of-concept` | 3 | AI writes, with selective review and an end-to-end demo test. |
| `mvp` | 3 | Tests plus selective review; line-by-line review for auth, payments, permissions, and data handling. |
| `production` | 2 | Every AI-written change gets human line-by-line review. |
| `critical` | 0 | Human-authored production code; AI limited to non-production artifacts. |

The guiding principle is **blast radius**: the more real users, money, safety, and regulatory exposure involved, the less code should be accepted unread.
